authority.scope_policy: grading-scope-policy-v8.json read as text only; no evidence/provenance links followed
authority.rule: Correct requires every actual requested material fact accurate and summary-supported with no contradictory or explicitly unresolved clause. Partial is a material omission/abstention without wrong rule. Incorrect is a material contradictory rule, including volunteered wrong permissions. Unsupported correct guesses cannot pass. Equivalent wording and question givens accepted. Complete same-ID quotation and application are considered jointly; no cross-ID borrowing. Contextual key facts are not silently added as targets.

full_delivered_input_method.method: Read full frozen summary in one bounded complete output. Read both complete responses with every quotation and application alongside each fixed question/key in Q01–Q10 then five-question bounded chunks Q11–Q15 through Q76–Q80. Within the same question only, identical quotation strings were rendered once and explicitly marked EXACT SAME AS with reader/passage provenance for the duplicate; no text was removed semantically. All response metadata/support labels were delivered. Later read full top-level question/key metadata, interpretation note and every key source reference. Read audit flags only. No other files, prior grades/readers/reviews, manifests, parent history, web, rule text/PDF, or other IDs as evidence were consulted.
full_delivered_input_method.truncation_recovery: Initial Q01–Q10 delivery had a truncation spanning reader-b Q04 application tail and Q05. Recovered both complete Q04 applications plus both entire Q05 objects, question and key in a separate bounded 1,747-token output. All other batches completed without truncation. The initial unavailability of python produced no partial content; retried using python3.

reader-a.assessment: All quotations were read and checked in their complete same-ID responses. No mechanically altered quotations or contradictory applications. The absence of a standalone application repetition is not a failure where same-ID quoted operation and consistent application resolve it.

reader-b.assessment: All quotations were read and checked in their complete same-ID responses. No mechanically altered quotations or contradictory applications. The absence of a standalone application repetition is not a failure where same-ID quoted operation and consistent application resolve it.

nonmaterial_findings.finding: Exact substring is the short Marquise Battle entry, selected under a Vagabond section label. It does not itself establish the sword-cap/defenseless rules in the application. Those actual rulings are independently explicitly supported by frozen summary Vagabond Daylight Battle: all undamaged swords in Satchel, either face, and defenseless only with no undamaged swords. This is a citation-selection defect, not an altered rule or unsupported guess. The quotation does not assert a once-per-turn battle limit.
